name: slack-board
description: Board of Slack messages for you: drafts replies in your tone of voice and sends them after your approval

port.title: Board port
port.description: Local port the board page is served on (127.0.0.1 only)

jira_site.title: Jira site
jira_site.description: Atlassian site hostname for ticket details and actions, e.g. yourteam.atlassian.net. Empty turns the Jira features off.

jira_projects.title: Jira project keys
jira_projects.description: Comma-separated Jira project keys that count as tickets in messages, e.g. PROJ,OPS. Empty finds no tickets.

sync_minutes.title: Sync interval (minutes)
sync_minutes.description: How often Slack is checked while Claude Code is open

polish_replies.title: Polish replies with Claude
polish_replies.description: On: Claude turns your note into a reply in your style and you approve it. Off: your text is sent exactly as you wrote it.

style_prompt.title: Reply style prompt
style_prompt.description: How Claude should write your replies. Empty uses your tone of voice file, or the built-in style when that file does not exist.

tone_of_voice_file.title: Tone of voice file
tone_of_voice_file.description: Markdown file with your writing style for drafted replies. When the file does not exist, a built-in plain and friendly style is used.

lookback_days.title: Lookback (days)
lookback_days.description: How far back the first sync looks for messages, and how long a message stays in Other messages

notify_new_messages.title: Notify about new messages
notify_new_messages.description: A notification when someone writes to you: who, where and the start of the message

notify_claude_done.title: Notify when Claude is done
notify_claude_done.description: A notification when Claude's draft is ready to approve or Claude answered a prompt in Actions

notify_send_failed.title: Notify when a send fails
notify_send_failed.description: A notification when a reply, reaction or approved step did not go out

notify_sync_failed.title: Notify when syncing fails
notify_sync_failed.description: A notification when checking Slack starts failing, not on every retry
